Description: A desert planet holds the only source of a substance that enables interstellar travel. A young heir is drawn into ecological politics, prophecy and revenge across shifting sands.
A burned out computer hacker is hired for one last job in a neon lit future of corporate espionage, artificial intelligence and body modification.
An envoy arrives on a frozen world where inhabitants have no fixed gender, and must navigate politics and friendship across deep cultural difference.
A pizza delivery driver and hacker uncovers a virus that spreads through both computers and human minds in a fragmented corporate America.
A mathematician predicts the collapse of a galactic empire and establishes a colony to shorten the coming dark age.
A physicist travels between an anarchist moon and the wealthy planet it rejected, testing both societies against each other.
Seven pilgrims travel to a distant world, each telling the story that brought them to a creature that moves backward through time.
The last fragment of a destroyed warship's consciousness, now in a single human body, pursues revenge across an empire.
A lone astronaut wakes with no memory aboard a ship sent to solve a crisis that threatens the sun itself.
An artificial friend observes human love and illness from a shop window and then from inside a family home.
A comfortable hobbit is pulled into a journey across mountains and forests to reclaim treasure guarded by a dragon.
A gifted young mage releases a shadow through pride and must sail the archipelago to face what he made.
An innkeeper recounts his life as a gifted musician, student of magic, and the legend that grew around him.
In an ash covered empire, a street thief discovers she can draw power from swallowed metals and joins a plot against a god king.
On a continent wracked by geological catastrophe, people who can quiet earthquakes are enslaved for their power.
A man lives alone in an endless house of statues and tides, keeping careful notes, until evidence of another world appears.
Two young magicians are bound to a contest inside a circus that appears without warning and opens only at night.
Two magicians revive English magic during the Napoleonic wars and fall into rivalry and dangerous bargains.
An angel and a demon, both fond of life on earth, try to prevent an apocalypse after misplacing the antichrist.

Book-Title: The Ocean at the End of the Lane
Description: A man returns to his childhood home and remembers a neighbour's pond that was really an ocean, and what came through it.
A private detective takes a blackmail case in Los Angeles and finds pornography, missing persons and a family rotting from within.
A wife disappears on her anniversary and the husband becomes a suspect as the marriage's real shape emerges.

Book-Title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
Description: A disgraced journalist and a brilliant hacker investigate a woman missing for forty years from a wealthy Swedish family.
Ten strangers are invited to an island and begin dying one by one in the order of a nursery rhyme.
A woman shoots her husband and never speaks again. A psychotherapist becomes obsessed with making her talk.
A detective investigates a child's murder in the same woods where his friends vanished when he was twelve.
Four residents of a retirement village meet weekly to review cold cases, then a real killing arrives on their doorstep.
A young bride arrives at her husband's estate and finds it still governed by the memory of his first wife.
A sharp witted young woman and a proud landowner misjudge each other repeatedly in a society organised around marriage and money.
An orphaned governess builds a self against cruelty and falls in love with a man keeping a secret in his attic.
A foundling and the daughter of the house destroy two families across generations on the Yorkshire moors.
An orphan receives money from an unknown benefactor and learns what his new gentility actually costs.
A poor student murders a pawnbroker to test a theory about extraordinary men, then cannot live with what follows.
A married woman's affair destroys her position while a landowner searches for meaning in work and faith.
A sailor joins a whaling voyage commanded by a captain consumed by the white whale that took his leg.
A single June day in London, moving between a woman preparing a party and a veteran unravelling from shell shock.
A mysterious millionaire throws parties for a woman across the bay, in a summer of wealth and careless ruin.
Seven generations of a family found and lose a town where the miraculous is treated as ordinary weather.
A sweeping account of how one human species came to dominate the planet through shared fictions, agriculture and empire.
An argument that geography rather than culture explains why some societies conquered others.
Two bicycle shop owners from Ohio solve controlled flight through patience, argument and relentless testing.
A history of Rome that asks how a small town became an empire and what ordinary Romans actually thought.
World history retold with central Asia at the centre rather than Europe.
Two systems of thought, one quick and intuitive and one slow and deliberate, and the predictable errors the fast one makes.
Small changes compound. A framework for building habits by design rather than relying on motivation.
An argument that sustained concentration is becoming rare and valuable, and a method for protecting it.
The case that introversion is a temperament rather than a deficiency, and that institutions are built for the wrong half.
A psychiatrist's account of the camps and the conclusion that meaning, not pleasure, is what sustains people.
How trauma lodges in the body and what approaches actually help people recover.
Practical craft advice for programmers on debugging, abstraction, automation and not repeating yourself.
What makes code readable, and the habits that keep a codebase maintainable as it grows.
How storage, replication, consistency and stream processing actually work in large systems.
Why adding people to a late software project makes it later, and other durable lessons about building systems.
A practical path through scikit-learn and neural networks, built around working code rather than theory first.
A mathematical treatment of supervised and unsupervised learning for readers comfortable with statistics.
A woman raised by survivalists with no schooling teaches herself enough to reach Cambridge, at the cost of her family.
Growing up mixed race in apartheid South Africa, where the author's existence was itself illegal.
A neurosurgeon diagnosed with lung cancer writes about what makes a life meaningful when it is being shortened.
A childhood of poverty and chaos with brilliant, negligent parents, recounted without self pity.
A formerly enslaved woman is visited by the daughter she killed to keep from slavery, in a house that will not settle.
Students at an English boarding school slowly understand what they were made for.
A father and son walk south through ash toward the coast, carrying fire in a world that has ended.
Four friends in New York across decades, centred on one man's refusal to speak about his past.
Two Irish students circle each other from school through university, unable to say what they mean.
The ghosts in a Washington graveyard observe a grieving president visiting his son's crypt.
An English butler drives across the country and slowly recognises the cost of a life given to service.
Three lives intersect during the Biafran war, from academic households into famine and flight.
